result: partial (ratio bounded by 2, known); odd-k change open
notes: Ratio dgon(G)/dgon(sigma_k G) lies in [1, 2] (dgon_r(G) <= 2 dgon_r(Gamma(G)) - r, JCTA 2022); change occurs for sigma_2 (tricycles), so for even k (or k = 1 inserted vertex). Odd k (sigma_k) open, listed open in the same paper; our exhaustive search finds no odd-k drop (T_m k <= 5, T_ms k <= 3, 407 generalised tricycles, all 994 connected graphs <= 7 vertices with dgon <= 5 at k = 3).
